description:
# [1.7.0-dev.1](https://github.com/dumb-software/T2C-App-Patch-Morphe/compare/v1.6.0...v1.7.0-dev.1) (2026-08-18)


### Features

* **patches:** add custom map styles, security bypass, and granular endpoints ([2de2237](https://github.com/dumb-software/T2C-App-Patch-Morphe/commit/2de2237667a59af532107262a8bc8b0c30a8a91d))

patches.name: Bypass maintenance and force update
patches.description: Disables maintenance lock and force-update screens by overriding the status endpoint.

patches.name: Change API endpoint
patches.description: Points the app to a custom backend server by modifying environment variables.

options.description: Enter the base URL for the API (e.g., https://api.t2c.fr)

patches.name: Custom Google Maps API key
patches.description: Replaces the Google Maps API key in the manifest with a custom one.

options.description: Enter your custom Google Maps Android API key

patches.name: Custom map style
patches.description: Replaces Google Maps styling with Dark Mode, AMOLED, or Retro theme.

options.description: Select the Google Maps style to apply

patches.name: Custom microservices endpoints
patches.description: Points individual microservices to custom server URLs.

options.description: URL for the SIV passenger information service
URL for the Editorial & Traffic alerts service
URL for the Push Notifications service
URL for the User Favorites service
URL for the Status & Maintenance service

patches.name: Custom Umami endpoint
patches.description: Points the app to a custom Umami analytics server.

options.description: Enter the base URL for Umami (e.g., https://analytics.t2c.fr/api/send)

patches.name: Disable background location service
patches.description: Disables persistent background location service and wake locks to save battery.

patches.name: Enable network interception
patches.description: Enables cleartext HTTP traffic and user-installed certificate trust for debugging.

patches.name: Force environment
patches.description: Replaces the production environment variables with the developer or local ones.

patches.name: Remove Firebase tracking
patches.description: Removes Firebase App ID and Crashlytics API keys to disable Google tracking.

patches.name: Remove Google Maps API key
patches.description: Removes the Google Maps API key from the manifest to stop Google tracking.

patches.name: Remove Umami tracking
patches.description: Disables Umami tracking safely by modifying existing environment values.
